# [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL Database provisioning in MSSQL extension

## What Changed

With Azure SQL Database provisioning, you can create and connect to a fully managed cloud database directly from your editor—at no cost. Now generally available, the feature also includes ready-to-use Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Bicep, and Terraform tem
